scope: Normal four-row cold resident Down arithmetic; original AXI response policy, READY backpressure, independent gold, final B and seven-cycle done hold. Static source review only.

findings.conclusion: Only pack valid/address/strobe/data grow to four row-indexed entries. Configuration, owner tag, identity and retirement authority are single unchanged instances.

Select only a sealed cache. Capture its pre-edge value into tx then clear local selected cache. A same-row merge sees the cleared valid bit and starts the next beat; a different-row merge only writes held_row. Other caches stay intact.

Original packet tile/row/mask/final/owner checks are byte-identical. Pending lane bits clear by beat_mask; a new packet is accepted only when the old held packet finishes or is empty. NBA replacement cannot change the old held_row used by the merge.

Transfer requires no old tx or actual b_fire. AW/W VALID and payload equations are unchanged and do not withdraw on fault. READY0 or one channel already sent cannot replace the old tx; B consumes or atomically replaces it.
Existing bad-held/B-error/bad-packet branch clears every unsent row cache and held packet while preserving an existing tx. Inherited error-entry gaps below remain outside the measured normal scope.
Flush can seal all valid row caches. Debt zero and flush_done require held packet empty, every cache empty and tx empty after its physical B. Original coverage/retirement checks are byte-identical.
A held row waiting for an address-changing cache cannot admit new packets. Other sealed rows are finitely drained, then that row can transfer and merge; no new normal-path deadlock was found.

inherited_unmeasured_error_windows.name: bad incoming packet and cache transfer in same edge
inherited_unmeasured_error_windows.reasoning: transfer_pack does not gate on a newly invalid packet handshake. The edge can create t=1 from a previously unpresented sealed cache, then fault clears p/h but retains t. New AW/W can appear after this fault edge. This exact policy is inherited; it does not prove that only already-presented old tx survives an error.

inherited_unmeasured_error_windows.name: stray B while tx is empty
inherited_unmeasured_error_windows.reasoning: The unchanged unsolicited B branch sets fault but does not clear held/pack state. With such unsent state present, later transfer/merge are fault-gated and debt zero need not be reachable. General error recovery is unmeasured.

root_scope_decision: Keep inherited fault policy for this KB1; stop any experimental error. Do not add generic fault recovery experiments. Production integration requires affected error regressions and is not closed by this local KB.

expected_unmeasured_effect.note: Hypothesis/declared coverage only; same TB full must observe it after KB0 completion.
